missions.acceptance: validate actual operated steps, result, and artifact separately; language and intake-only are insufficient
missions.custody: separate task author and evaluator account context under the same workspace administrator; not independent administrator, production grading authority, or #565 custody
missions.selection: all eight cases remain in denominator; resource limits can yield NOT TESTED rather than pass

strategic.acceptance: exact candidate lower/upper enclose independent minimax LP values to 1e-7 * max(1, payoff scale), interval width <= 5e-7 * max(1, payoff scale), and all distributions feasible
strategic.comparison: separate enumerated normal-form pure strategies, primal and dual HiGHS, and separately recomputed candidate bounds from returned row and column plans using exact rational arithmetic
strategic.full_dense_bound: perform explicit matrices for up to 6,000,000 integers per case; beyond that use separable exact candidate certificate bounds, do not describe absent brute-force as a win
strategic.selection: six fixed boundary/scientific controls plus five reproducibly generated cases before source freeze
